definition: what remains when something is burned
description: Inside a stone fireplace in a wooden chalet a young man in a cream jumper kneels and builds a fire: he sets split logs upright against each other on the thick grey bed of burnt powder that covers the fireplace floor. The wood catches, flames climb up between the logs, and he sits back on his heels smiling at it. The shot then cuts outside to the same chalet at dusk, snow on the roof and warm yellow windows, with a plume of white smoke rising from the chimney into a deep blue sky.

de.answer: Er macht ein Feuer im Kamin.
de.question: Was macht der Mann?

es.answer: Está haciendo un fuego en la chimenea.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el hombre?

fr.answer: Il fait un feu dans la cheminée.
fr.question: Que fait l'homme ?
